title: Bitwise ORs of Subarrays
summary: For an integer array arr, count the unique bitwise OR results from all non-empty subarrays.
statement: For an integer array arr, count the unique bitwise OR results from all non-empty subarrays. The bitwise OR of a single element is the element itself. A subarray consists of consecutive elements from the original array.
constraints: Count distinct bitwise-OR results over all nonempty contiguous subarrays.
hints: Many previous ORs collapse to the same value.
Keep the set of ORs ending at the previous index.
Form {value} union {old|value}, and add it to a global set.
Each subarray is represented when its right endpoint is processed.
editorial: Each subarray is represented when its right endpoint is processed.

tests.explanation: The only subarray has OR zero.
